standard-dialogue-if-the-player-does-not.player: Hmm, I wonder if there's something I could use to communicate with him.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-gh.npc: Aaah! What are you doing down here!?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-gh.player: Hey, keep it down! I've come to slay the monsters down here.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-gh.npc: Oh, that's ok then. These vile creatures do make an awful racket.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-gh.player: You should hear it upstairs! Those Aberrant Spectres are just the worst.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-gh.npc: I'm Raulyn. Once servant to the great Viggora who built this place centuries ago.
This was, of course, before the building started to sink into the swamp...
Oh, and the darn Zamorakian mages. They didn't help matters. Always making a mess.
I've been here ever since. You're the first person I've spoken to in over 200 years.
Sometimes, but it's not all that bad. I hope you stop by more often!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-a-gh.player: Hopefully! I should be going now, speak to you later.

when-attempting-to-kill-monsters-that-ar.npc: I don't think that's what you're meant to be slaying.
